description: This Java class 'CompressedSubscriptions' manages local subscriptions for topic distribution using hash code sequences, including methods for creating instances, handling topic addition/removal, exporting updates, and equality checks.

classes.name: CompressedSubscriptions
classes.description: Manages compressed topic subscriptions with hash code sequences, supporting addition, removal, export, and equality operations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of CompressedSubscriptions with specified hash function seeds.

methods.name: hashTopic
methods.description: Computes hash codes for a given topic string and converts to ByteString.

methods.name: onNewTopic
methods.description: Handles logic when a new topic is added, updating hash code counts and insertions.

methods.name: onRemovedTopic
methods.description: Handles logic when a topic is removed, updating hash code counts and deletions.

methods.name: getSeeds
methods.description: Returns the collection of hash function seeds.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports current updates, forcing full update if specified.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another CompressedSubscriptions object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on internal fields.
